Subject: Request: POC timeline slip — credits & short extension

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Quick update from our side — the engineering team hit an unexpected blocker with the API adapter for our legacy data store. The integration sprint that was due to finish this week has slid into next month; were now looking at ~2–3 weeks of additional engineering work.

We want to keep the POC moving without asking your engineers for extra time. Can Redwood provide a modest credits top-up and a short extension on the sandbox window so we can finish the adapter and validate at scale? Our procurement folks are aligned but wont sign anything until the SOW is updated (attached).

What would help: a ~3-week sandbox extension and an extra 40k token credit allocation tied to this POC (non-billable). If you need more details from our tech team I can loop them in.

Attachments: integration_log.txt (excerpt), architecture_notes.pdf (high-level)

Thanks,
Alice Park
Head of Platform
Prodive Inc

Subject: Re: Request: POC timeline slip — credits & short extension

Thanks for the heads-up, Alice — really appreciate the context and the logs. Sorry to hear about the adapter snag.

Short answer: we can usually approve a short sandbox extension + a targeted credit top-up for engineering-blocker scenarios like this. Ill need a couple of quick things to get formal approval from finance:
- Confirm the exact dates youre asking for (start/end) and whether the extension should be contiguous with your existing sandbox window.
- A short ETA from your lead engineer (even a range is fine).
- Confirmation that the requested tokens are only for POC testing and wont be used beyond validation.

If you can send those by end of day Monday Ill escalate to Ben for sign-off and loop Marissa to prep the billing/credit object. We can also offer an interim 2-week token allotment immediately while approvals are processed.

On the process side: once Ben signs off well create a one-off credit allocation on your account (non-recurring) and extend the sandbox window in the console. Ill include a DocuSign link for the small one-page amendment to the POC SOW to keep procurement happy.

Cheers,

--

Thanks, Soojin. Quick answers below:

- Dates: Can you extend the sandbox from 2027-04-15 -> 2027-05-06 (three weeks) so it aligns with our internal sprint finish.
- ETA: our lead (Marco Ruiz) estimates 10–14 business days to finish the adapter + a 2-day validation window.
- Token use: confirmed — only for POC validation and load tests; not for production.

I attached a redlined SOW-draft.docx (minor schedule changes only). Procurement wants the DocuSign amendment so they can attach it to the purchase folder.

Appreciate the interim 2-week allotment offer — that would help keep things moving while approvals are routed.

Best,
Alice
